description: Changes in how an AI engine cites, reported in public, that can move every brand's citation rate at once. cli/geo_watch.py holds the same list in ENGINE_EVENTS (a test keeps them equal); watch diff names the events dated between two runs, and watch report the events of the 30 days before a run. Reported figures are as reported and not verified by geo-score; they describe the engines' consumer products unless surface says otherwise, and the APIs geo-score measures may not follow.

events.observed: Pages cited per answer fell from about 27 to about 20, and the share of citations that point to a brand's own website from about 33% to about 24%.
events.source: A third-party monitoring dataset of several hundred million answers, presented in public in November 2026.

events.observed: Citations of reddit.com fell by about 84% in the second half of October.
events.source: The same dataset, presented in public in November 2026. The exact date was not given; the range is the second half of October.
